description: This file contains the implementation of the Identifier class within the Opencart admin localisation model. It provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving identifier records from the database, with a focus on database interactions and cache management.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Model class for managing identifier records in the database, including CRUD operations and data retrieval.

methods.name: addIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a new identifier record in the database with provided data, returns the primary key.

methods.name: editIdentifier
methods.description: Updates an existing identifier record identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes an identifier record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a specific identifier record by ID.

methods.name: getIdentifierByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an identifier record based on its code.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Fetches multiple identifier records, optionally filtered by pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns the total count of identifier records in the database.
